name: navigator-scan-permission-coherence-test
body:
The coherence e2e test that pins the navigator's scan-permission grant so it cannot silently regress. It EXTENDS the existing test `rust.main_e2e.e2e.coordinator_agent_carries_review_action_and_dispatch_prose` (`tests/main_e2e.rs`, which already asserts the navigator frontmatter grant `apg_review_action: allow` and the coordinator dispatch/isolation protocol) with needles over the embedded `codebase-navigator.md` prompt: the frontmatter grants `apg_scan: ask` (and `apg_scan: allow` is absent), and the removed scan-consent prose ("ask the user first", "get explicit approval before starting one", "ask the user before running a scan", "(after user approval)") is absent. The fn name is unchanged — renaming would break the prior change-set's durable implemented-by edge — and its doc comment is updated to say it pins the navigator's permission grants (review-action + scan) and the dispatch/isolation protocol. The test is `code_type = 'test'` and lives in the root crate's `tests/main_e2e.rs`.

Deliberately a NARROW branch-added owner, distinct from `solution.component.codebase-navigator-prompt` (which owns the prompt file 1:1 and is implemented-by `opencode-suite/agents/codebase-navigator.md`): a satisfied requirement's spine is coverage-checked (`rust.apg.plan_cmd.verify.coverage_check`), and the two changed surfaces (the prompt and the test) are different files, so each gets its own component and no component's implemented-by set spans an untouched file. It is also distinct from the pre-existing `solution.component.navigator-isolation-coherence-test` (exempt from coverage because it is not branch-added); overlapping implemented-by ownership of the same test fn is established practice. It sits under `solution.container.scanner-cli` (the root-crate test surface, where the sibling test-bearing component `solution.component.navigator-isolation-coherence-test` and `solution.component.distributed-agent-install` also live).

implemented-by: `rust.main_e2e.e2e.coordinator_agent_carries_review_action_and_dispatch_prose` (resolves in the branch graph, `tests/main_e2e.rs:2148-2266`, `code_type = 'test'`). No planned Implementation node is needed — the test edit is a `modifies` over an existing FQN.
